title: PD 957 License to Sell Registration Gate

documents.document_version_date_or_edition: Revised IRR as local source file

claims.claim_text: No owner or dealer shall sell any disposable subdivision lot or condominium unit in the registered project without a license to sell issued by the Board.
claims.article_location: The rule that decides the answer

claims.claim_text: The license to sell is issued within two weeks from registration of each project after proper application and requirements.
Application evidence includes public-offering materials such as circulars, prospectuses, brochures, advertisements, or communications.
claims.article_location: Public offering materials are part of the paper trail
claims.locator: Rule IV / application documentary requirement excerpt / PDF p.43
